__HIDDENCAT__
These are articles which may require confirmation, research, or testing.

Code: {{tl|verify}}

This template is intended for use when a statement needs verification. Clicking on it links to the '''talk page''' of the page it is included on, where any discussion of the question should be raised and conducted.  If there is no current Discussion page, the link will be '''red'''. Including the template also adds the page to Category:Verify.  (Template at [[template:verify]]).
